invariants: One native screen coordinates the document surface and shared reading controls.
One ordered collection determines the central homepage layout and entrance sequence; the policy entry occupies its own footer.
The sheet and popover share the same list and successfully opened original-file records.
Preview, source and outline derive from one working Markdown buffer.
One window-width policy coordinates both auxiliary panels; actual reserved width is shared with native controls.
Expanded and collapsed states reuse one native toggle and reserve no document width when collapsed.
The icon-only toggle and pane are absent when the document has no outline entries; empty headings remain entries.
Automatic following scrolls only the outline pane and yields to manual outline browsing.
All rows share one leading control geometry and one layer of interaction feedback.
Both document modes reuse the same AI, mode-switch and More controls; source history actions join this group.
All window widths retain one trailing disclosure; source focus and window resizing preserve its expanded state.
Expansion keeps the disclosure anchored and action slots stable; actions travel left and return along the same path while the chevron rotates continuously, including rapid reversals.
Collapsed actions neither receive touches nor appear in the accessibility tree, and their vacant slots pass document input through.
More shares SwiftUI symbol rendering and motion with adjacent actions; its transparent native button owns menu interaction only.
The fixed More menu keeps its contents stable throughout presentation; surrounding state updates must not replace an in-flight touch target.
Native keyboard geometry positions the shared group above input UI without intercepting touches outside the controls; only input covering the entire bottom edge reduces the document viewport.
System keyboard animation timing stays in charge; unanimated input-toolbar guide updates receive interruptible native layout animation, without changing keyboard geometry.
One system AI action forwards the actual selection from either document mode.
Global and selection entries share one conversation across compact and regular presentations.
The collapse control floats over the conversation without a dedicated header row; assistant content retains shared reading insets.
The side-panel collapse control shares the document close control's horizontal centerline and hit-target size; panel top and bottom margins may differ.
Outline and conversation are mutually exclusive when three readable columns do not fit; narrowing retains the last actively used panel and widening does not reopen either.
Outline, document close and conversation collapse share native SF artwork and point size, centered without enlarging glyphs within the shared canvas; independent targets remain 44pt.
Sent turns and their reference snapshots remain immutable.
Following observes both content and viewport size; only navigation intent changes it, preserving manual browsing across layout changes.
One draft and its next-turn reference share the native input bridge.
The reference sits above one input capsule; native text and the Web send button have separate hit regions within it.
Selection references preserve the complete selected content and its original structural relationships.
Each turn owns its rendered content, references, anchors and request status.
Only the latest failed turn can replace its answer through an explicit retry.
Three waiting dots belong to the pending answer and retire on its first visible content; completion, failure, stop and reset remove active feedback without discarding content or drafts.
Cards represent applied document edits and their current save and history state.
Content surfaces share the parser, sanitizer and offline extensions.
Message and reference anchors are scoped to their own rendered content.
One native modal owns settings navigation and blocks the underlying reader.
Configuration resumes the original AI entry only for the same document and never submits a question.
Returning home follows successful document closure or explicit discard after a failed save.

One close control moves to the document column’s leading edge while a side conversation is open, stays distinct from outline controls, and returns to the trailing edge on collapse; its wind-up, dash and landing retarget from the current pose and respect Reduce Motion.
Retry and discard begin after the save-failure alert finishes dismissal, so an immediate repeated failure presents a new alert.
The native document model owns one working text and one undo history for typing, composition, paste, AI transactions, system editing actions and touch controls.
One quiet homepage entry presents the bundled policy with native text, lists, tables and scrolling in the App language.
The first send to each service requires explicit native approval; cancellation preserves the draft and reference without starting a request.
A tap opens the native Reference in AI Chat menu shared with text selections; long presses and secondary clicks retain WebKit image actions.
Menu references are captured once and checked against the active document token.
